text: Business combinations prior to June 30, 2009 The different accounting treatments applicable to these business combinations are as follows: transaction costs directly attributable to the acquisition were included in the acquisition cost; non-controlling interests (previously referred to as "minority interests") were measured at the share of net assets acquired; step acquisitions were recognized separately and did not affect subsequently recognized goodwill. Control of the Company No shareholder, alone or in concert with others, directly or indirectly, has held a controlling interest in the Company or has been deemed to exercise control over the Company. [#6695](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-6695)
In January 2024, the Group acquired the non-controlling interests, which amounted to a 50% stake, in Casbu SL in Spain. [#5725](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-5725)

Moreover, for each business combination, the Group measures the non-controlling interests in the acquiree either at fair value or at the Group's proportionate share of the acquiree's identifiable net assets. [#5655](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-5655)
Repurchase commitments to non-controlling interests are recognized as liabilities. [#6145](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000259591248-6145)
